profile.headline: Software and Systems Engineer at Raytheon Technologies
profile.summary:
As a Principal Software Engineer at Raytheon Technologies, I apply my skills and knowledge in natural language processing (NLP), model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and test automation to deliver high-quality software products and solutions for various defense and aerospace projects. I have over 16 years of experience in software engineering, with a Master of Engineering degree in Cybersecurity from The Johns Hopkins University.

I lead the development of a requirements analysis tool that uses NLP tools and technologies, such as SpaCy and NLTK, to intelligently detect ambiguities or defects and ensure engineers maintain high-quality requirements. I also independently plan and develop test automation scripts for new and legacy products using Python and Selenium, reducing the test period from two weeks for every product release to only two hours per day. Additionally, I apply MBSE processes to lead the development and architecture of a tool that automates the creation of contract data requirements list (CDRL) and other reports using Rational Publishing Engine (RPE) for IBM’s DOORS Next Generation (DNG). I am passionate about creating innovative and efficient software solutions that meet the needs and expectations of our customers and stakeholders.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the development of a requirements analysis tool using NLP tools and technologies (such as SpaCy and NLTK). The tool intelligently detects ambiguities or defects and ensures engineers maintain high-quality requirements.

Independently planned and developed test automation scripts for new and legacy products using Python and Selenium, reducing the test period from two weeks for every product release to only two hours per day.

Applied Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) processes to lead the development and architecture of a tool that automates the creation of Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) and other reports using Rational Publishing Engine (RPE) for IBM’s DOORS Next Generation (DNG), Rational Team Concert (RTC), and Rhapsody.

Supported multiple programs throughout the company as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) of RPE templating, utilizing the DOORS Classic, DNG, RTC, and Rhapsody data sources at the request of program leadership.

Led a series of tutorial courses at the Pentagon on the use of the software applications developed by our program.

Served as the sole developer and maintainer of the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Microsoft Access database, including user-level support for adding new features and debugging issues.

Led and participated in multiple operating system migrations, obsolescence testing cycles, COTS and FOSS upgrades, and mitigation activities, including Solaris to Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) migration and RHEL to CentOS.

Applied Agile Scrum methodology to all team projects leveraging the Jira tool, and participated in regular stand-up meetings to present status, plans, risks, and goals.

Served as a SME across multiple programs for technical and troubleshooting support for customers, Help Desk staff, and coworkers, via in-person sessions, phone, and virtual meetings.
positions.insights: Problem Solving, Test Data and +19 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performing software engineering tasks on space related applications including development, maintenance, and testing for the Space Shuttle, International Space Station and Satellite projects.
Team lead for the Consolidated Planning System (CPS) Team.

Managed team’s weekly status reports, weekly meetings and was the primary contact.
Responsible for researching solutions for Anomaly Reports (ARs) and Internal Discrepancy Reports (IDRs), implementing those solutions, and presenting code inspections after each solution was implemented.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Tutored algebra, trigonometry, calculus I and II, Spanish I-IV, computer programming courses, and physics.
